formats.label: Berliner
formats.caveat: Printer/publisher printable area and bleed are separate; verify the chosen printer's spec.

formats.label: US Broadsheet (configurable baseline)
formats.caveat: Published sources give different dimensions for US Broadsheet (e.g. 381×533 mm and 381×578 mm). Treat this as a named starting preset only; verify the printer spec and always allow custom dimensions.

formats.label: Newspaper Tabloid / Compact (configurable baseline)
formats.caveat: Newspaper tabloid and office/ANSI tabloid aren't interchangeable across all regions.

formats.label: A3
formats.caveat: Add bleed outside trim size only for a print profile that requires it.

formats.label: A4
formats.caveat: Add bleed outside trim size only for a print profile that requires it.

exportProfiles.label: PDF डाउनलोड
exportProfiles.description: Ordinary downloadable PDF; exact page size, fonts, images and readable text are required.

exportProfiles.label: प्रिंटिंग प्रेस के लिए PDF
exportProfiles.description: Require the chosen printer's trim, bleed, safe-area, colour-profile and PDF/X rules; don't assume one universal value.
